scope: One local look-development candidate; provisional Demo 01 identity, not actual Grifon output.
axis: Trust through physical credibility and a clear product focal point
method: Independent Codex still critique and code review, no paid rubric scorer or numeric ranking
reference_limit: Physical staging and material separation only; not a coffee-specific quality benchmark

rounds.gap: Planar label lettering casts a separate shadow and reads as raised signage.
rounds.correctness: Bottle is 0.0095 scene units above the plinth.

rounds.resolved: Label vertices follow the paper cylinder; whole bottle assembly meets the support.
rounds.gap: Lower bottle reads honey-gold while shoulder reads dark brown.

rounds.change: Neutral glass and transmissive coffee with IOR 1.333 and volume absorption density 30.
rounds.result: Clear-glass shoulder improves, but lower bottle remains gold. Stop at cap.

remaining_issue: Lower bottle reads bright gold, closely matching the pedestal and weakening continuous coffee-fill appearance.
optical_diagnosis: A dominant plinth reflection is an inference, not a verified cause.

negative_control.input: Actual round-1 Blender backup before correction

limits: Geometry checks do not grade rendered materials.
No full-film, motion, conversion or reference-beaten claim.
No paid AI/render operation or product app change.
